questions.stem: What does sustainability mean in the context of resource use?

options.text: Using as many resources as possible before they run out
Meeting current needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their needs
Only using resources that are found underground
Replacing all natural resources with synthetic alternatives

questions.explanation: Sustainability means meeting present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs. It involves balancing environmental protection, economic prosperity, and social wellbeing. For resources, this means using them at a rate that allows renewal or finding alternatives.

questions.stem: Why is high atom economy important for sustainable chemistry?

options.text: It means more reactant atoms end up in the desired product, producing less waste
It only works with organic compounds

questions.explanation: High atom economy means a larger proportion of the atoms from the reactants end up in the desired product rather than in waste by-products. This reduces waste, makes better use of raw materials, conserves finite resources, and produces less pollution. Addition reactions have 100% atom economy, while substitution reactions are lower.
